short_description:
GTA 6's Vice City vs real Miami, five places pinned on Rockstar's official Leonida map: Little Cuba (Little Havana), Downtown (downtown Miami), Port Vice City (PortMiami), the VCIA airport (Miami International) and Vice-Dale County (Miami-Dade). Each match is in two or more guides; Rockstar itself names Little Cuba and the VC Port. Sources: Rockstar Games, Forbes, GTA6 Life, The Miami Guide, Miami New Times, iTechGuides, Quartz, Axios.
